mapper.select: select id, conversation_id as conversationId, sender_id as senderId, msg_type as msgType, content, status, check_status as checkStatus, version from im_message where id = #{id} for update

select m.id, m.conversation_id as conversationId, m.sender_id as senderId, m.msg_type as msgType, m.content, m.extra_json as extraJson, m.status, m.check_status as checkStatus, m.version, m.edited_at as editedAt, m.create_time as createTime, coalesce(u.nickname, u.name) as senderName, u.avatar as senderAvatar from im_message m left join ums_member u on u.id = m.sender_id and m.sender_id > 0 where m.id in #{i}
mapper.update: update im_message set content = #{content}, version = version + 1, edited_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{expected} and status = 0
update im_message set status = 1, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{expected} and status = 0
mapper.insert: insert into im_message_revision(message_id, revision_no, content, check_status, editor_id, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{revisionNo}, #{content}, #{checkStatus}, #{editorId}, current_timestamp(3))
insert into im_message_mutation(conversation_id, message_id, version, kind, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{version}, #{kind}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select id, message_id as messageId, version, kind from im_message_mutation where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and id > #{after} order by id asc limit #{limit}
select max(id) from im_message_mutation where conversation_id = #{conversationId}

select p.id, p.message_id as messageId, p.conversation_id as conversationId, p.sort_no as sortNo, left(coalesce(m.content, ''), 120) as summary from im_message_pin p join im_message m on m.id = p.message_id where p.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and m.status = 0 order by p.sort_no desc, p.id desc limit 20
select id, message_id as messageId, sort_no as sortNo from im_message_pin where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by sort_no desc, id desc for update
mapper.insert: insert into im_message_pin(conversation_id, message_id, sort_no, pinned_by, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{sortNo}, #{pinnedBy}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.delete: delete from im_message_pin where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.update: update im_message_pin set sort_no = #{sortNo} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into im_message_mention(message_id, mention_type, target_id) values (#{messageId}, #{type}, #{targetId})
mapper.select: select message_id as messageId, mention_type as mentionType, target_id as targetId from im_message_mention where message_id in #{i}
select min(create_time) from im_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
select m.id from im_message m where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and and m.id < #{anchor} order by m.id desc limit #{limit}
select m.id from im_message m where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} and and m.id > #{anchor} order by m.id asc limit #{limit}
select max(create_time) from im_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and sender_id = #{senderId}
